name: ai-enabler-kpi
displayName: AI Enabler KPI — AI usage measurement
description: Measures how AI is used in a project through passive, opt-in hooks: human interaction (prompts, approvals, questions, interruptions), AI working time versus human waiting and thinking time, output (files and lines written by the AI, commits, pull requests) and token usage with its cost in USD per session, user, ticket, skill and model. `/ai-enabler-kpi:kpi-report` turns the captured events into Markdown, HTML, JSON and CSV reports. Works with any workflow, not only the ai-enabler pipeline.
